name: Suspicious letter
description: An unsigned letter about the administration. Press Enter to read.
readingText:
Do not believe the reports sent to the capital. The shelves are empty, yet the administration insists that every delivery has arrived. Someone is altering the supply registers.

Keep copies of the original records. When we have enough proof, we will send them beyond the checkpoint without Sokolov's approval. Until then, speak only to people you trust.

Do not sign your next letter.
